description: AGSC-11-24: a peer entry may state a relationship and a crosswalk of SKOS mapping statements, which a federating client applies to the results it derives from that peer. Derivation: the node a.example lists b.example as a shared-kernel peer with the crosswalk domain/b.ttl, which says that its concept https://a.example/concepts/account/ is skos:exactMatch to https://b.example/concepts/account/. A search over b.example returns that concept and another that the crosswalk does not mention. Both results carry trust untrusted and origin https://b.example/ (AGSC-11-11) and the relationship shared-kernel; the first carries the member crosswalk with one object, match exactMatch and local the a.example concept; the second has no crosswalk member. Nothing is merged into a.example's items and no Link is made (AGSC-11-12).
